from vision_client import get_vision_client
from vision_models import create_image_from_bytes, create_feature, parse_label_annotations
from google.cloud import vision

def detect_image_labels(image_content: bytes) -> list:
    client = get_vision_client()
    image = create_image_from_bytes(image_content)
    feature = create_feature(vision.Feature.Type.LABEL_DETECTION)
    response = client.annotate_image(request={'image': image, 'features': [feature]})
    return parse_label_annotations(response)

from vision_client import get_vision_client
from vision_models import create_image_from_bytes, create_feature, parse_label_annotations
from google.cloud import vision

def describe_image(image_content: bytes) -> str:
    client = get_vision_client()
    image = create_image_from_bytes(image_content)
    feature = create_feature(vision.Feature.Type.LABEL_DETECTION)
    response = client.annotate_image(request={'image': image, 'features': [feature]})
    labels = parse_label_annotations(response)
    if labels:
        descriptions = [label["description"] for label in labels if label["score"] > 0.7]
        if descriptions:
            return f"An image featuring: {', '.join(descriptions)}."
    return "A visual description could not be generated."

from vision_client import get_vision_client

def detect_image_text(image_content: bytes) -> str:
    client = get_vision_client()
    image = create_image_from_bytes(image_content)
    feature = create_feature(vision.Feature.Type.TEXT_DETECTION)
    response = client.annotate_image(request={'image': image, 'features': [feature]})
    if response.text_annotations:
        # The first annotation is the full text detected in the image.
        return response.text_annotations[0].description
    return "No text detected."

from vision_client import get_vision_client
from vision_models import create_image_from_bytes, create_feature
from google.cloud import vision
from typing import Dict, Any

def score_image_safety(image_content: bytes) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client = get_vision_client()
    image = create_image_from_bytes(image_content)
    feature = create_feature(vision.Feature.Type.SAFE_SEARCH_DETECTION)
    response = client.annotate_image(request={'image': image, 'features': [feature]})
    safe_search_annotation = response.safe_search_annotation

    safety_scores = {
        "adult": safe_search_annotation.adult.name,  # UNKNOWN, VERY_UNLIKELY, UNLIKELY, POSSIBLE, LIKELY, VERY_LIKELY
        "spoof": safe_search_annotation.spoof.name,
        "medical": safe_search_annotation.medical.name,
        "violence": safe_search_annotation.violence.name,
        "racy": safe_search_annotation.racy.name,
    }
    return safety_scores

from google.cloud import storage

def upload_to_gcs(bucket_name: str, blob_name: str, data: bytes, content_type: str = "application/octet-stream") -> str:
    storage_client = storage.Client()
    bucket = storage_client.bucket(bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(blob_name)
    blob.upload_from_string(data, content_type=content_type)
    return f"gs://{bucket_name}/{blob_name}"

def upload_string_to_gcs(bucket_name: str, blob_name: str, content: str, content_type: str = "text/plain") -> str:
    storage_client = storage.Client()
    bucket = storage_client.bucket(bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(blob_name)
    blob.upload_from_string(content, content_type=content_type)
    return f"gs://{bucket_name}/{blob_name}"
